title: ITIN structural test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of Individual Taxpayer Identification Number candidates paired with IRS YY-bucket classifications. Mirrors the Swift ``detectITINs`` regex and the paired tightening that enforces YY in [50-65, 70-88, 90-92, 94-99].

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one ITIN candidate with its expected YY-bucket verdict.

itin.description: ITIN candidate in ``9AA-YY-SSSS`` format. Area code always starts with 9.

valid.description: Whether the candidate passes the IRS YY-bucket gate.

yy_bucket.description: Whether YY falls in one of the IRS ranges [50-65, 70-88, 90-92, 94-99].

rejection_reason.description: Which rule rejects this ITIN, or null if valid.
